reason: The cited evidence (E1-E3) focuses entirely on MD simulations of phase separation and deformation in Co-Cr-Cu-Fe-Ni, a system not among the Cr-Mn-Fe-Co-Ni alloys under investigation. None of the passages provide any data or discussion on local atomic environments, stability, or mechanical properties of the target alloy system, leaving all key premises unsupported by the cited prior evidence.
premises: Local atomic structural environments differ among equiatomic Cr-Mn-Fe-Co-Ni and its subsets.
These local environments are influenced by composition and processing conditions.
Differences in local environments govern variations in mechanical properties (strength, ductility, toughness).
The equiatomic quinary alloy has a more stable and homogeneous local environment than its subsets.
This more stable/homogeneous environment leads to improved mechanical properties in the quinary alloy.
